answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 42 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 11 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 42 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 500 bought sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the ripple here is verification, the knoll of cost is what stops the farm, and the hollow of the record keeps every claim checkable.
